title: AI can spend your tokens while you do nothing
description:
More background AI means more invisible usage. Automations and memory processing can consume quota even when you are not actively chatting.

If you want AI to keep working while you step away, passive token use belongs in the budget.

Watch the full episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/ie/podcast/youre-using-the-wrong-ai-model-for-writing/id1073349789?i=1000786574042
